_about: T325: review domains that are CLOSED (locked). The exporter (`pipeline.regs.review.export`), the apply command (`pipeline.regs.review.apply`) and the review app skip each one; marks.jsonl is never edited. Close: `python -m pipeline.regs.review.lock <domain>`. Reopen: remove the entry (`lock --reopen <domain>`).

closed.why: T329 (owner 2026-10-30): a pond call only confirms the lake default; nothing reads it, the build never uses it
